status: Implemented; local controller regression and both negative controls pass. Full local matrix and style running; live executor shard pending.

failure.cause: A completed baseline exceeds an arbitrary 64-MiB inspection limit inside the already bounded 512-MiB fault volume. The case exits before ENOSPC injection.
failure.observed_image_size: The failed run reports only that the limit is exceeded; the exact image size is not in that failure. Add baseline capacity, available bytes and image size to the case log.

change: Remove only the per-image inspection limit. Preserve the exact mount identity and 512-MiB capacity checks, finite filler bound, real ENOSPC requirement, lease, cleanup ownership and all distributed recovery assertions. The controller can inspect a large baseline both before and during exhaustion. The actual recovery copy must still fit and verify; this change does not promise arbitrary state fits a finite volume.

local_probe.runtime: python:3.13-alpine in one owned Docker container, no network, no added capabilities, read-only root, 512-MiB tmpfs, 120-second parent deadline and bounded cleanup.
local_probe.files: 80-MiB baseline and 160-MiB replacement, real writes and fsync. These files are not MDBX images.
proof: Baseline size exceeds the old 64-MiB limit.
Exact controller reaches kernel ENOSPC and reports zero available bytes.
Baseline digest survives exhaustion and release.
Controller ages the baseline beyond six hours without waiting for that duration.
After release, a larger replacement is written and inspected on the same bounded filesystem.
local_probe.actor_complement: The existing state-aux-enospc target separately verifies real StateWriter, checkpoint/log failures, continued commits, restored account/storage state and resumed block-log replay.
local_probe.controls: Nine Python controller boundary checks; three Rust job/proof wrappers; one ignored-by-default kernel test.

service_wiring: One local probe step is added to the existing Docker CI job. No chaos shard, product service wiring or runtime defaults change.
performance: No product hot-path change. The deployed fault retains its 512-MiB limit. The local probe temporarily uses at most that tmpfs size and removes its container on completion.
